notes.format: choices: '<table>.<field>' -> [{value,label,sequence,dependentValue}]; tables use the SDK JSON column shape; constants are engine seeds.
notes.on_hold_reason: change_request.on_hold_reason and change_task.on_hold_reason are free-text strings (SDK: string, maxLength 4000); no choice list.
notes.risk: Highest risk = lowest non-empty numeric value. API samples document Moderate=3 and Low=4; values 1 (Very High) and 2 (High) are inferred. The API field table claiming 1 High/2 Moderate/3 Low is treated as an error.
